name: Gia be
summary: Giá bể, also written giá bể xào, is a Hải Phòng snack at Cát Bi market and the afternoon markets.
origin: Hai Phong. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023.
howToEat: Eat it at the market counters. The map puts market snacks in the afternoon.
A method and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Cát Bi, and chợ Cố Đạo, chợ Chu Văn An, and chợ An Dương. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Gia be — a Hai Phong market snack
seoDescription: A Hải Phòng snack, also written giá bể xào, at Cát Bi and the afternoon markets.
